subject.title: Mostrar en el panel de Auto Packing qué regalo incluir en cada pedido

question: Should this assigned Auto Packing feature stay with AlexDiaz-Hamelyn, or should a maintainer explicitly hand it to ClawSweeper later?
rationale: Repository policy requires coordination before taking over an issue already assigned to someone else, even though the implementation boundary is clear.

options.title: Leave with assigned owner
options.body: AlexDiaz-Hamelyn keeps the issue and implements or delegates the Admin Auto Packing change through the normal team workflow.

options.title: Hand to ClawSweeper later
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly unassign or approve automation, after which a focused API/UI PR would be reasonable.

recommendation.title: Leave with assigned owner
recommendation.body: AlexDiaz-Hamelyn keeps the issue and implements or delegates the Admin Auto Packing change through the normal team workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to this user and they have recent history in the Auto Packing UI area.
